units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 3:1:3">Y. Shek. III, beg. 47ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>חבר ות׳</he>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 158b:6">B. Bath. 158ᵇ</cite> <he>ת׳ חבר</he>, v. <cite ref="H00109"><he>חָבֵר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Eruvin 63a:18">Erub. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>האב ובנו הרב ותַלְמִידוֹ שניהם וכ׳</he> a father and his son, or a teacher and his pupil have only one vote.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 11a:7">Snh. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>תלמידו של עזרא</he> a disciple (worthy successor) of Ezra.

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:12">Ab. IV, 12</cite> <he>כבוד תַּלְמִידְךָ</he>, v. <cite ref="K00037"><he>כָּבוֹד</he></cite>; a. v. fr.—<he>ת׳ חכם</he>, v. <cite ref="H00941"><he>חָכָם</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>תַּלְמִידִים</he>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:19">Ib. V, 19</cite> <he>תַּלְמִידָיו של אברהם וכ׳</he> disciples (followers of the example) of our father Abraham; <he>ת׳ של בלעם וכ׳</he> disciples of Balaam the wicked.

<cite ref="Taanit 7a:14">Taan. 7ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>ומתַּלְמִירַי</he>, v. <cite ref="L00565"><he>לָמֵד</he></cite>. Y. Maas. Sh. II, end, 53ᵈ <he>אלו הן הת׳</he> these are meant by ‘the disciples’; a. v. fr.—<he>תַּלְמִידֵי חכמים</he>, v. <cite ref="H00941"><he>חָכָם</he></cite>.
